package.name: follow_planner
package.description: Turns the locked human target (dtp_msgs/Target) into a moving standoff-viewpoint goal for SUPER, published on /dtp/follow_goal (arbitrated against NAV by command_mux before reaching SUPER's follow-goal ingestion). Also publishes the person's position on /planning/yaw_target, which is what drives SUPER's YAW_TO_TARGET heading -- note that topic name: fsm_node subscribes cfg_.yaw_target_topic, NOT the /dtp/target_point that plan/dtp-imp/01 SS2 lists, and the mismatch fails silently. Modeled on mission_planner/include/waypoint_mission/ros2_waypoint_planner.hpp. See plan/dtp-imp/07 (Phase 2) for the full design.
